summary.text: Tiffany Roberts is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 149, York County, representing North Berwick and South Berwick.
The page lists Tiffany Roberts as chair of the Inland Fisheries and Wildlife committee.

paragraphs.text: The page lists Tiffany Roberts's occupation as Digital Marketer.
Listed affiliations include Marshwood Schools Volunteer, SOBO Central Volunteer and Program Marketing and Sponsorships, Great Works Regional Land Trust Member.
Tiffany Roberts lives in South Berwick and has served 4 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Committee assignments listed: Inland Fisheries and Wildlife (chair).
Family details on the page: 3 children.
